name: 1ccc10f04d46
claim: windows-peer-ca.pem is byte-identical to the Mac orama-lan-ca-PHLab-H2LGBV3.pem (DER SHA-256 364490e8, valid Oct 2026 to Oct 2028); the 8443 portal serves a distinct self-signed CN=orama-mac.local (SHA-256 53c1ef1f, valid Nov 2026 to Dec 2026). Each direction must pin the correct peer cert, not assume one shared CA.

decisions.notes: diff confirmed windows-peer-ca.pem equals orama-lan-ca-PHLab-H2LGBV3.pem (364490e8 DER); openssl s_client on 8443 served CN=orama-mac.local (53c1ef1f).

rationale: Verify which cert each endpoint actually presents before pinning; do not assume the peer CA equals the portal cert.
